display_name: Singapore succession — Wills, Intestate Succession, Probate and Administration, Guardianship of Infants
citation: Wills Act 1838; Intestate Succession Act 1967; Probate and Administration Act 1934; Guardianship of Infants Act 1934 (2020 Rev Ed)

source.note: FOUR Acts encoded as ONE subject against a shared ontology: they are four views of one event -- a death in a family -- and they share their nouns. Official texts fetched from Singapore Statutes Online as PDFs (the HTML landing page returns headings only for a long Act); every sha256 is over the PDF bytes. Full provenance in each encoding's registers/source-bundle.json; re-run its source/fetch-sso.py to reproduce the fetch. The Administration of Muslim Law Act 1966 is captured as a corroboration document because ISA s 2 excludes Muslim estates into it; the cleanroom encoding adds the Interpretation Act 1965 and the Civil Law Act 1909 as corroborations on the age of majority.

encodings_note: THE SUBJECT IS FOUR ACTS; THE ENCODINGS COVER DIFFERENT SUBSETS OF IT, and the widened display_name above is a claim about the subject and not about any one encoding. 'legalese' covers the Wills / Intestate Succession / Probate trio, law as at 18 Aug 2026. 'cleanroom-2026-08' covers all four, law as at 26 Aug 2026, and is the only one carrying the Guardianship of Infants Act 1934. A reader who takes the display_name as a statement about 'legalese' would be wrong, which is why this sentence is here and not only in a commit message. The two are INDEPENDENT encodings, not versions of each other: the second was written without reading the first, so that its report/denovo-diff.md is a measurement rather than a self-check.
